name: power_dual_buck
title: HeyPCB Dual Rail - 6-15 V in, 5 V / 3 A and 3.3 V / 2 A out
brief: Dual-rail buck module for the bench and for projects: 6-15 V DC enters on a 5 mm screw terminal behind a reverse-polarity P-FET (10 V gate clamp) and an SMAJ15A TVS; a TPS563201 makes 5 V / 3 A and an AP63203 makes 3.3 V / 2 A, both straight from the protected input; a green LED on each rail; VIN, 5V, 3V3 and GND on a 2.54 mm header; four M3 holes; 50 x 36 mm, 4 layers.

blocks.title: 6-15 V input: reverse-polarity P-FET, TVS, bulk

netClasses.name: PWR_HI
netClasses.why: up to 3 A on 5V and on the TPS563201's switch node, about 2 A on the input at 6 V: IPC-2221 gives about 1.4 mm on a 1 oz outer layer for 3 A at a 10 C rise. The raw input and the switch node are named in the brief (block nets are otherwise prefixed with the block's lead ref, and a class naming them would match nothing: measured on rev A's first build, where both routed at 0.2 mm).

netClasses.name: PWR_3V3
netClasses.why: 2 A from the AP63203 and on its switch node: about 0.8 mm on a 1 oz outer layer at a 10 C rise

rules.why_min_track: Freerouting may neck a power track into a SOT-23-6 pin; JLCPCB multilayer builds 0.09 mm

board.notes: 4 layers: F.Cu / In1 GND plane / In2 routing / B.Cu. In1 is a Specctra power layer during routing; every leftover area is poured GND after routing.

zones.name: vin_raw
zones.why: terminal + pin to the FET's drain: the whole input current

zones.name: vin_in
zones.why: FET source to the input bulk and TVS, stitched into In2's VIN plane, which carries VIN to both converters

zones.name: sw5
zones.why: TPS563201 SW pin to the inductor: 3 A peak

zones.name: out5
zones.why: inductor output, the three output caps and the header's 5V pin

zones.name: sw3
zones.why: AP63203 SW pin to the inductor: 2 A

zones.name: out3
zones.why: inductor output, the two output caps and the header's 3V3 pin

zones.name: vin5
zones.why: the TPS563201's VIN pin and its three input caps on one copper area, reaching up over the inductor where stitch vias to In2's VIN plane fit (the area at the pin is all courtyards)

zones.name: vin3
zones.why: the AP63203's IN pin and its input cap on one copper area, stitched to In2's VIN plane

vin:J?.why: supply wires enter the left edge, between the two left M3 holes

out:J?.why: output header along the right edge, pin 1 (VIN) at the top, centred on the board

vin:Q?.why: drain level with the terminal's + pin, 1.25 mm clear of the terminal body; source toward the bulk

vin:C1?.why: input bulk beside the FET's source

vin:C2?.why: input bulk beside the FET's source

vin:D2?.why: TVS on the protected input, above the bulk

buck5:U?.why: turned so GND / SW / VIN (TPS563201 pins 1-3, one side) face the inductor on the right

buck5:L?.why: inductor straight out from the SW pin: about 3.6 mm of switch node

buck5:C3?.why: 100 nF input cap closest to the VIN pin

buck5:C1?.why: 22 uF input cap beside the VIN pin

buck5:C2?.why: 22 uF input cap beside the VIN pin

buck5:R1?.why: feedback divider top, by VFB, away from the switch node

buck5:C4?.why: bootstrap cap between VBST and SW

buck5:C5?.why: 5 V output cap at the inductor's output

buck5:C6?.why: 5 V output cap at the inductor's output

buck5:C7?.why: 5 V output cap at the inductor's output

buck3:U?.why: AP63203 with IN and GND on its bottom corners and SW on the right

buck3:L?.why: inductor straight out from the SW pin: about 2.4 mm of switch node

buck3:C1?.why: 10 uF input cap bridging IN and GND directly under the converter

buck3:C2?.why: bootstrap cap between BST and SW

buck3:C3?.why: 3.3 V output cap at the inductor's output

buck3:C4?.why: 3.3 V output cap at the inductor's output

led5:R?.why: 5 V LED near the top edge, clear of the top-right M3 hole

led3:R?.why: 3.3 V LED near the bottom edge, clear of the bottom-right M3 hole

route.why: the esp32s3_lipo ladder: narrow the classes that carry an open net straight to 0.2 mm; the outline is stated, so it is never grown

switches.why: + beside the terminal pin that takes the supply's positive lead, - beside GND (a polarity triangle alone is ambiguous on a power input)

captions.place_3d: KiCad's raytracer on the placed board: the input terminal on the left edge, the 5 V buck above the 3.3 V buck, the output header on the right edge.
captions.done_3d: 6-15 V in, reverse-polarity FET + TVS, TPS563201 5 V / 3 A, AP63203 3.3 V / 2 A, two rail LEDs, VIN/5V/3V3/GND header.
